changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[FieldDetail] as SELECT T.ID AS FieldTypeID, T.Name, T.FriendlyName, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID AS AssetID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, T.Type, COALESCE (F.Value, F.FormattedValue, T.DefaultValue) AS Value, CASE WHEN T.AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN CAST(T.AllowAllLabel AS nvarchar(MAX)) WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN T.DefaultFormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T .DefaultFormattedValue AS nvarchar(MAX)) ELSE NULL END AS FormattedValue, T.ShowIfEmpty FROM dbo.Asset AS A INNER JOIN dbo.FieldType AS T ON T.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON F.FieldTypeID = T.ID AND F.ObjectType = A.Object AND F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID WHERE F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL OR T.DefaultValue IS NOT NULL OR T.ShowIfEmpty = 1
changeSet.rollback: create or alter view [dbo].[FieldDetail] as SELECT T.ID AS FieldTypeID, T.Name, T.FriendlyName, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID AS AssetID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, T.Type, COALESCE (F.Value, T.DefaultValue) AS Value, CASE WHEN T.AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN CAST(T.AllowAllLabel AS nvarchar(MAX)) WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN T.DefaultFormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T .DefaultFormattedValue AS nvarchar(MAX)) ELSE NULL END AS FormattedValue, T.ShowIfEmpty FROM dbo.Asset AS A INNER JOIN dbo.FieldType AS T ON T.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON F.FieldTypeID = T.ID AND F.ObjectType = A.Object AND F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID WHERE F.Value IS NOT NULL OR T.DefaultValue IS NOT NULL OR T.ShowIfEmpty = 1
